summary: Iteration 116 refactor-verification: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_116_refactor.py covering all 7 review items after the insurance_delivery split + server.py lifespan rewrite + emailer._sender_identity extraction. 16/16 tests PASS serially (-n 0). Highlights: (1) GET /api/health => 200 ok; grep of /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log shows all 7 schedulers started (document reminder, zami status + session keepalive, zami otp reminder, cart reminder, document retention, daily digest, insurance price sync) and NO NameError/traceback -- confirms the _init_startup_state + _background_loops rewrite is stable. (2) POST /api/orders with insurance line: missing insured => 400 'Poliçe kesilebilmesi için 1 sigortalının...TC kimlik...'; missing travel_start => 400 'Poliçe gidiş tarihinizde başlar; lütfen gidiş tarihini seçin.'; valid payload (TCKN 10000000146, birth 1990-01-15, travel_start) => 200, ref SV-59HJQ2PP. (3) PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id} payment_status=paid queues insurance task (status='pending'); POST /api/admin/insurance-tasks/{task_id}/issue with policy_file_id='test-policy-file' returns ok=true, task.status='issued', email.status ∈ {sent,error,skipped} and whatsapp.status='manual' with wa.me link containing SV- order code + PDF link -- verifies new insurance_delivery.issue_policy works and routes_admin.py:1324 imports it correctly. (4) GET /api/account/documents (customer JWT for delivered@resend.dev) returns the just-issued policy with kind='policy' and download_url starting with /api/files/; POST /api/account/documents/{id}/resend returns 200 status='sent' (validates routes_account resend importing policy_html from insurance_delivery); unknown id => 404. (5) GET /api/admin/insurance/provider => configured=true, auto_issue=false, urun_id='141', last_sync_at present, 4 active products (3 additional legacy inactive rows returned but only 4 active is the spec). POST /api/admin/insurance/sync-prices returns 4 rows, 0 errors, and every price == round(cost*2/10)*10. NO issue-provider endpoint was called and NO UI button starting with insurance-issue-provider- was clicked. (6) GET /api/admin/daily-digest/preview + calling emailer.daily_digest_html on the returned payload contains all 5 headings: 'Dün gelen başvurular', 'Tahsilat', 'Ekstra satışlar', 'Dikkat gerektirenler', 'Ay başından bugüne'; GET /api/admin/today also 200 -- confirms the _digest_intro/_digest_apps_block/_digest_revenue_block/_digest_attention_block/_digest_admin_button split. (7) TestEmailPipeline::test_contact_creates_outbox_entry (re-run in isolation) passes: POST /api/contact => 200, /api/admin/emails outbox grows -- confirms the emailer._sender_identity() extraction did not break send_email. Frontend Playwright smoke: /vize-tipleri renders single [data-testid=addon-card-express] (no addon-card-instant_express); /admin/sigorta shows Tamamliyo panel state 'Bağlı', 'Son fiyat senkronu 07.09.2026 20:44', ürün kodu 141, auto-issue toggle 'Kapalı', and rows for Seyahat Sağlık Sigortası 7/15/30/60 (issue-provider buttons NOT clicked); /hesabim (customer JWT delivered@resend.dev) shows 'Belgelerim' heading with Seyahat Sağlık Sigortası cards and all three actions ('İndir', 'WhatsApp'tan gönder', 'E-postama tekrar gönder'). Test data was cleaned up (2 orders + 1 insurance task deleted). Provider prices left untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/insurance/provider returns 7 product rows (4 active + 3 legacy inactive like ins_8d and ins_30d_plus). The spec says '4 product rows'. Filtering by active=True on the API side (or the current UI-side filter) yields exactly 4, so this is documented behaviour, but consider adding an 'active_only' query param to make the contract explicit.

routes_account.py:326 imports policy_html from insurance_delivery inside the function body (import-time hot path is fine since the module has no side effects); consider hoisting the import to module top like routes_admin/insurance_provider now do, to keep the pattern consistent.

insurance_delivery._close_task writes delivery.policy_file_id but only if task.order_id is set — good; would benefit from an assertion/log when order_id missing so we don't silently lose delivery metadata.
test_credentials: Admin JWT: python /app/backend/admin_test_token.py. Customer JWT for delivered@resend.dev via routes_account._create_session_token. Valid TCKN 10000000146.
seed_data_creation: 2 store orders (SV-59HJQ2PP paid+issued, SV-6OZOP01F pending) and 1 insurance task were created for the manual-issue flow and DELETED at end via db.orders_col + insurance_tasks_col direct cleanup. Provider prices untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests/test_iteration_116_refactor.py with -n 0 (serial) because the class-level pytest attributes (order_id, task_id, doc_id) are chained via pytest.iter116_* module attrs and xdist splits classes across workers. /api/contact has a per-IP rate-limit (~5/hr); if you must re-run the email-pipeline test in a full suite, start with it or use -n 0. NEVER call POST /api/admin/insurance-tasks/{id}/issue-provider nor click any UI button whose testid starts with insurance-issue-provider-* -- it triggers a real paid Tamamliyo policy.
rca of the issue: N/A -- refactor introduced no regression. Initial test failures were purely fixture-shape issues in my test (insured field name is tc_kimlik_no not national_id; provider panel returns active+inactive rows; sync-prices row keys are cost/price not cost_try/price_try). All fixed in-file, no product code changed.
